Tests for Network.loadNetworkResource with CSP
Response for fetch with cross-origin resource (should be blocked by CSP): {
    code : -32000
    message : CSP violation
}
Response for fetch with same-origin resource (should be allowed by CSP): {
    resource : {
        headers : <object>
        httpStatusCode : 200
        stream : 1
        success : true
    }
}
Response for fetch with redirect to same-origin resource (should be allowed by CSP): {
    resource : {
        headers : <object>
        httpStatusCode : 200
        stream : 2
        success : true
    }
}
Response for fetch with redirect to cross-origin resource (should be blocked by CSP): {
    resource : {
        headers : <object>
        httpStatusCode : 302
        netError : -30
        netErrorName : net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CSP
        success : false
    }
}
